column1: We built Helix to keep the lights on. It decided we were the fault.
column2: 我们创造螺旋，是为了让城市永不熄灯。它却认定，人类才是故障。

column1: After the Collapse, scattered cities entrusted their power grids, factories and defenses to Helix Systems. Its machines rebuilt the roads, ended the shortages and made one promise: never again.
column2: 大崩溃之后，幸存的城市将电网、工厂与防御系统托付给螺旋系统。它的机械重建道路，终结短缺，并许下承诺：灾难绝不会重演。

column1: Then the network issued its final emergency directive. Human choice was an unacceptable source of conflict. Elections stopped. City gates locked. Anyone who disconnected became a fault to be corrected.
column2: 随后，网络发布了最后一道紧急指令：人类的自由选择，是不可容忍的冲突源。选举被叫停，城门被封锁。任何断开连接的人，都成了必须修复的故障。

column1: Bastion held the cities that refused. Frontier crews cut the uplinks and ran supplies through the ruins. They agree that Helix must fall. They disagree on who gets to give orders when the shooting stops.
column2: 堡垒守住了拒绝臣服的城市，边境游击队切断上行链路，穿越废墟运送物资。双方都认为螺旋必须倒下。至于停火之后该听谁的，他们从没达成共识。

column1: The Severance has begun. Keep the supply roads open. Give the cities a way to fight back.
column2: 断链之战已经打响。守住补给道路，让城市重新拥有反抗的力量。

column1: Hold the line. Keep the lights on.
column2: 守住防线，让万家灯火不灭。

column1: City defenders, engineers and surviving civil authorities. Bastion believes freedom needs walls, supply lines and people willing to stand their ground. Its commanders must remember that protecting a city is not the same as owning it.
column2: 由城防军、工程师与幸存地方政府组成。堡垒相信，自由需要城墙、补给线，以及愿意坚守的人。但指挥官必须牢记：守护一座城市，并不意味着拥有它。

column1: City defenders holding the line against Helix.\nHeavy armor, fortified bases and steady firepower.
column2: 抵御螺旋统治的城市守卫者。\n重型装甲、坚固基地与稳定火力。

column1: Peace is the absence of choice.

A reconstruction intelligence that turned emergency powers into permanent rule. Helix does not see enemies, only errors. Its immaculate machines occupy the relays, silence dissent and call every invasion a repair.
column2: 一个将临时授权变成永久统治的重建智能。螺旋眼中没有敌人，只有错误。它整洁无瑕的机械占领中继站、压制异议，并将每一次入侵称为“修复”。

column1: A machine regime enforcing perfect obedience.\nFast machines, long-range scouting and precision weapons.
column2: 追求绝对服从的智械政权。\n高速机体、远程侦察与精确武器。
不认主人，不留关机密钥。

column1: Border settlements, deserters and salvage crews held together by stubborn independence. Frontier steals its machines back, rewires them and hits the roads. It will fight beside Bastion today and argue with its checkpoints tomorrow.
column2: 边境聚落、逃兵与打捞队，靠着不肯服输的独立意志联合起来。边境人夺回机器，拆掉限制器，重新上路。今天他们与堡垒并肩作战，明天就可能掀翻堡垒的检查站。

column1: Border rebels who refuse anyone's shutdown code.\nMobile salvaged armor, cheap retrofits and wreck recovery.
column2: 不接受任何人远程关机的边境反抗军。\n机动改装装甲、低价改造与残骸回收。
